sentences.text: thereby, his father was allotted 'A' Schedule property measuring about 1.47 acres and subsequent to his father's death, his family members are enjoying the said property.
Thereafter in the year 2019, it came to light that the respondent / Housing Board had acquired the said lands for constructing housing units for Lower Income group.

Later, it came to light that an Award for the said acquisition was passed on 23.09.1986, after publishing 6(1) Declaration, whereas it is unknown whether the compensation amount was received by his father or not.

3. It is further stated that after some time, due to non implementation of the project, the Housing Scheme introduced by the respondents had become defunct, but the core issue is that his lands were not released to him.

Pursuant to introduction of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency Act,
the land acquisition proceedings https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis initiated under the Old Act is deemed to have lapsed and therefore, earlier he filed writ petition in W.P. No.35205 of 2019 seeking for an appropriate relief.

sentences.text: That being the position, the 1st respondent has passed the impugned order dated 05.03.2019, whereby they introduced a proposal of sale of the subject lands as vacant plots.
Challenging the said order, this writ petition has been filed.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that since all the lands except petitioner's land have been released to the respective owners, the act of the respondents showing difference is arbitrary and illegal.

On instructions, he further submits that though the petitioner prayed for a larger relief in this writ petition, now, the petitioner restricts his prayer to the extent that the petitioner may be permitted to submit a fresh representation to the respondents seeking for allotment under Ex- Owners Category.
Therefore, he seeks for issuance of appropriate directions in the above aspect.

5. Though, the learned counsel for the respondents denied the contention that there is no provision in the scheme for reallotment of vacant land under Ex- owner category, but submitted that he has no o b j e c t i o n f o r i s s u a n c e o f a d i r e c t i o n t o e n a b l e t h e p e t i t i o n e r t o s u b m i t https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis fresh representation to the respondents seeking for appropriate relief, as prayed supra.
6.
Heard the learned counsel on both sides and perused the materials placed on record.

7. Though the writ petition has been filed for a larger relief, however, considering the restricted prayer sought for by the petitioner, this Court directs the petitioner to submit a fresh representation along with a copy of this order to the 1st respondent, within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

On receipt of the same, the 1st respondent shall pass appropriate orders on merits and in accordance with law after providing an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner as well as any other interested persons, within a period of six weeks thereafter.
8. This writ petition is disposed of with the aforesaid directions.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
